title: fkern-iter-logger: Modified FEMM kernel with Newton-Raphson convergence logging
description: A modified 64-bit FEMM 4.2 magnetic solver that writes the total number of Newton-Raphson iterations performed during an analysis to a plain-text .iter file.

creators.name: Valpiani, Federico
creators.affiliation: Department of Energy, Politecnico di Milano

notes: Derivative work based on FEMM 4.2 by David Meeker and distributed under the Aladdin Free Public License. Associated paper: Accelerating Magnetostatic FEM Simulations of Electric Machines with Echo State Networks, ICEM 2026.
